versions.changelog:
Initial release of beaded-bracelet-designer skill.

- Generate hand-drawn design sheets, multiview sketches, and interactive 3D beaded bracelet models from text prompts and reference images.
- Allows customization by gemstone images, gemstone types, metals, shapes, and materials.
- Supports various jewelry types including luxury bracelets, necklaces, rings, earrings, pet collars, and body chains.
- Provides REST API access via OneKey Agent Gateway with required API key setup.
- Includes online viewer and integration with the Craftsman Agent Jewelry Designer app.
